map.岩浆岩、沉积岩、变质岩三大类岩石的矿物成分、结构、构造与典型代表对照: A comparison of the mineral composition, texture, structure and typical representatives of the three main rock classes: igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic.
map.三大类岩石按成因与结构判别：岩浆岩由岩浆冷凝形成，侵入岩如花岗岩结晶粗粒、喷出岩: Distinguish the three rock classes by origin and texture: igneous rocks form by cooling of magma — intrusive rocks such as granite are coarsely crystalline, extrusive rocks such as basalt are dense and vesicular; sedimentary rocks such as sandstone, shale and limestone have bedding and fossils, often with clastic or chemical sedimentary textures; metamorphic rocks such as gneiss, schist, marble and slate have foliation and gneissose structure with oriented minerals; the criteria are texture and structure, mineral assemblage and mode of occurrence.
map.识别要点：先看构造（层理→沉积岩，片理/片麻理→变质岩，块状/气孔→岩浆岩），再: Identification points: first look at the structure (bedding → sedimentary, foliation/gneissosity → metamorphic, massive/vesicular → igneous), then the texture (crystalline/clastic/crystalloblastic) and mineral composition (quartz, feldspar, calcite, etc.).
map.📚 深度解析：三大岩类（岩浆/沉积/变质）野外识别: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Field Identification of the Three Rock Classes (Igneous/Sedimentary/Metamorphic)
map.岩类判别：按矿物成分、结构与构造区分岩浆岩、沉积岩、变质岩: Class discrimination: distinguish igneous, sedimentary and metamorphic rocks by mineral composition, texture and structure
map.代表确认：野外对照典型代表（如花岗岩、砂岩、片麻岩）快速定名: Representative confirmation: compare with typical representatives in the field (such as granite, sandstone, gneiss) for quick naming
map.教学科普：建立“成分—结构—构造”三联鉴定思路: Teaching: build a "composition-texture-structure" three-way identification approach
map.判别链：①看构造——层理→沉积岩、片理/片麻理→变质岩、块状→多属岩浆岩；②看结: Decision chain: ① look at the structure — bedding → sedimentary, foliation/gneissosity → metamorphic, massive → mostly igneous; ② look at the texture — clastic/argillaceous → sedimentary, crystalloblastic → metamorphic, holocrystalline/porphyritic → igneous; ③ look at the minerals — quartz + feldspar + dark minerals and coarse grains → granite family. Igneous rocks are classed by SiO₂ as acidic (>65%)/intermediate/basic/ultrabasic (local correlation table, no network needed).
map.例：某岩石含明显石英与钾长石、全晶质中粗粒、块状构造、SiO₂≈72% → 花岗: Example: a rock with obvious quartz and potassium feldspar, holocrystalline medium-coarse grains, massive structure, SiO₂≈72% → granite (acidic plutonic igneous); another black, dense, porphyritic/cryptocrystalline, vesicular → basalt (basic extrusive, SiO₂≈48%); one that effervesces strongly with dilute hydrochloric acid and has bedding → limestone (chemical/biogenic sedimentary rock).
map.花岗岩和流纹岩成分相近怎么分？: How do you distinguish granite and rhyolite, which have similar compositions?
map.二者都富石英+钾长石（酸性），区别在于产状与结构：花岗岩为深成全晶质中粗粒，流纹: Both are rich in quartz + potassium feldspar (acidic); the difference lies in the mode of occurrence and texture: granite is plutonic, holocrystalline and medium-coarse grained, while rhyolite is extrusive, porphyritic/cryptocrystalline and has flow banding. Look at the texture rather than the composition to distinguish them.
map.大理岩和石灰岩成分一样吗？: Do marble and limestone have the same composition?
map.主要成分都是方解石，但大理岩是石灰岩经区域/接触变质重结晶成粒状变晶、块状构造，: Their main component is both calcite, but marble is limestone recrystallised by regional/contact metamorphism into a granular crystalloblastic, massive rock; both effervesce with acid. The difference lies in the texture (crystalloblastic vs biogenic/chemical) and whether a metamorphic mineral assemblage is present.
